description: This file provides utilities for managing launchctl operations, including executing commands, parsing launch agent plist files, and extracting relevant configuration details such as environment variables, arguments, and file paths.

classes.name: Launchctl.Result
classes.description: Encapsulates the result of running a launchctl command, including the exit status and output.

classes.name: LaunchAgentPlistSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of a launch agent's plist configuration, including arguments, environment, paths, and network settings.

methods.name: Launchctl.run
methods.description: Executes a launchctl command asynchronously with provided arguments and returns a Result object containing the output and status.

methods.name: LaunchAgentPlist.snapshot
methods.description: Loads and parses a launch agent plist file from a URL, returning a snapshot of its configuration.
